comment: No source is published. Outputs 0 and 2 are written from the same value and always carry the identical signal, so both are tagged to the same line. The sustain CV is added to a knob whose range is 0 to 1, so one volt covers the whole control and there is no clamp on the total: above 1V the envelope and the outputs go past 10V. The attack time is floored at 1ms but the decay and release times are not, so a release of zero makes the envelope drop to nothing in a single sample. With Cycle on, the module skips the Trig input entirely.
